family_rule: Remove trailing digits across both releases; choose at most one per family only if later qualified
family_limit: Conservative name grouping is not recovery of original recording IDs; cross-family shared source is unverified

annotation_evidence.lines_166_176: Region count and color-to-region IDs are read from per-sequence definition files.
annotation_evidence.lines_204_208: Berkeley PGM is read as region labels with probability one.
annotation_evidence.lines_211_226: Freiburg PPM packs RGB as red*65536+green*256+blue, and the companion PGM is divided by255 for probabilities.
annotation_evidence.line_20: Gray visualization palette includes 255; it is not a universal void label.
annotation_evidence.lines_331_335: Evaluation subtracts one background region but does not establish universal raw-pixel background ID in this code.

incompatibility: A generic PGM-to-instance decoder could interpret confidence as object identity. No official universal 0-background/255-void contract was established; no largest-region heuristic or target-derived mapping was used.
legacy_bms_subset: PGM labels confirmed but universal background/void encoding not established from official documentation; not promoted to compatible holdout.
